_: THE STANDING MENU — Iddo edits this file, never the code. chef.py re-reads it at the top of every tick, so a change takes effect within one tick with no restart. Set 'enabled': false to take a shelf off the menu; change 'weight' to change how much of each meal comes from where.
_laws: A shelf with no 'license' is refused before anything moves — the nezer's provenance door would refuse it at the other end anyway.
The chef has no code path that can declare human:false. Synthetic material stays exam-negative and is placed by hand.
never_serve is checked by CONTENT (sha256) as well as by name, so renaming a held-out file does not smuggle it in.

never_serve._: The nezer's held-out exam session, 2026-07-04, and the two Café Claude eval days cafe_eval.py reserves verbatim: 'permanently excluded from any training pool'. Also the food eran3 has already been fed by hand, so it is never fed twice under a new source name.
never_serve._contains: filename_contains matches ANYWHERE in the name, not just at the front. It exists because the first live tick (2026-09-01 08:24) found 26 files named iddo1__cafe-20260704__NNNNN.wav in the ant-farm train split — segments cut out of the nezer's own held-out exam, which a prefix rule cannot see and whose sha256 differs from the exam WAVs because they were resampled.

shelves.note: THE SHELF THAT WAS NOT WHAT ITS LABEL SAID. Measured from the ant-farm manifest on 2026-09-01: of its 405 'train' clips, 150 carry speaker_id 'head-sim' (ERAN's simulated mouth — not a human, and food only for the exam's negative side), and 26 are named iddo1__cafe-20260704__* — segments of the nezer's own held-out exam. allow_contains is therefore a whitelist, not a blacklist: only clips whose name says iddo1__ may pass, and the reserved sessions are denied on top of that. ~188 clips survive both gates.
